# block_pockets_at_random_and_write { #mofography.raspa_helper.block_pockets_at_random_and_write }

```python
raspa_helper.block_pockets_at_random_and_write(
    file_path,
    rag,
    ase_atoms,
    random_seed=123,
)
```

> This function takes a graph, ase atoms object, and a file path, and writes a file with the
fractional coordinates of the centroids of the pockets in the graph, and the radius of the pockets

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type   | Description                                                                        | Default    |
|-------------|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| file_path   |        | the path to the file you want to write the blocking information to                 | _required_ |
| rag         |        | the networkx graph object                                                          | _required_ |
| ase_atoms   |        | ASE atoms object                                                                   | _required_ |
| random_seed |        | the random seed to use for the random number generator, defaults to 123 (optional) | `123`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                      |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | The blocking_fractions and _ are being returned. |
